scope: Read-only refresh of the project-owned Domain/OS SR10.4 framebuffer and MAME command channel before GTK2 native comparison.

method.before: No pending request; probe reports captured=false, paused=false, frameskip=4, throttled=false, ui_active=false.
method.action: One read-only screen:snapshot command against :apollo_screen:screen; no keyboard, mouse, host focus, guest file, VM setting, or process was changed.
method.after: Channel status is clean; no pending request or reply.

result: The current guest framebuffer is black. This records the current frame only and does not contradict the user's earlier physical wake. The guest is not paused and the live profile remains unchanged. The separate Prancheta MAME keeps verify.sh at exit 4, so no wake input or graphical comparison was attempted.
next: When the separate MAME releases the documented guard, revalidate the target PID/disk and channel, use the one-shot documented wake procedure only if the screen remains black, confirm the VUE target is visible, and continue the authorized GTK2 state comparison.
